newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African gold shares grab interest to close firm.
newsitem.headline: S.African gold shares grab interest to close firm.

text.p: South African gold and mining financial shares enjoyed most buying in fairly quiet trade on Monday, snatching interest as bullion held steady to finish comfortably firmer, dealers said.
Industrial shares on the other hand struggled to retrace losses in subdued trade after last week's run up and finished under opening levels.
But dealers said shares still offered value at lower levels so some buying later this week was expected.
With the London market on holiday, little foreign interest was enjoyed. Although with Wall Street's open some players were starting to awake, dealers said.
As the end of the European summer approached, renewed overseas institutional interest was expected.
Dealers said that if the rand and bullion held steady overnight and Wall Street remained firm, the local market could continue on an upward trend on Tuesday.
The overall index was off 6.7 points at 6,557.5, industrials fell 9.5 points to 7,724.3 and golds lifted 19.1 to 1,759.1.
